title: Publish open review findings and failing check output in the loop's status
requested_outcome: When the remote engineering loop blocks an objective, its published status.json says only, for example, 'convergence limit: 3 repair round(s) used of 3; findings F-01, F-02 ... remain' or 'result_refused: checks failed on <sha>: wording (exit 1)'. The Director who writes and requeues objectives cannot see the finding text or the failing check output, so every block needs the owner to read the host. Add to each request in the status projection: (1) the open findings of the latest independent review verdict - id, severity where recorded, and the finding text truncated to 600 characters, at most 10 findings; (2) for a refused result, the failing check's name and the tail of its output, at most 40 lines and 4000 characters; (3) for a worker-reported block, the full report text truncated to 4000 characters. Everything added passes through the loop's existing redaction so no secret, token, credential path or private key can appear, and the projection stays deterministic and bounded in size. Update REMOTE_ENGINEERING_CONTROL_V1.md to describe the new fields. Tests: a convergence-limited objective publishes its open findings; a refused result publishes the failing check's tail; a planted secret in check output or finding text is redacted; the size limits hold. If the finding text is not available to the projection from the kernel's records, report exactly where it lives instead of guessing. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: a blocked objective's status carries its open findings, failing check tail or worker report, each bounded
everything added is redacted by the loop's existing redaction, proven by a planted-secret test
existing remote-engineering tests pass with unchanged assertions
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
